description: Composition facts for Hot Sheet-owned wrappers of Kerf components. Kerf's ui-composition rule loads this file through .kerf-ui-profile.json `catalogs`; an entry's `rendersAs` lets the wrapper stand in for the cataloged root it renders inside Toolbar zones and parent checks (HS2-N5G6JS). The wrapper's own `parents` stay `any` because the rendered root already carries the Toolbar requirement; listing it twice makes the rule report the same placement twice. `placeableClasses` names the root class the wrapper itself writes onto that Kerf root. Keep each entry's id and source aligned with component-catalog-extension.json; catalog.test.ts checks that.

entries.name: TicketSearchField
entries.purpose: Ticket search query editor with inline filter chips, in-place tag completion, a lifecycle date helper, and syntax help.

obligations: Wire Kerf's wireTokenSearchFields for editor chrome, submit, and collapsible behavior.
Wire wireTicketSearchFields once per root and route every callback by the field id it receives.

behaviors: The consumer sizes and places the rendered group by context selector; helper popovers hang below it.

obligations: The help button, tag listbox, date group, and syntax dialog carry their own accessible names.
